units.text: INT. COURTROOM 4B - POWER OUTAGE - DAY
Emergency lights bleed amber across empty benches.
The air conditioner has died with a wheeze.
The judge's bench looms.
ADVOCATE LEONARD OSEI-BANKS (50s, double-breasted suit) stands at the defense table.
PROSECUTOR NADINE TOLLIVER-REEVES (40s, sleek braid) stands at hers.
The judge's bench is a dark shape; only a voice comes from it.
Your Honor, with the lights out, I move to adjourn.
units.name: LEONARD

units.text: Your Honor, the State opposes.
units.name: NADINE

units.text: Order! Counsel, I can hear you perfectly well.
units.name: JUDGE FAIRCHILD

units.text: Your Honor, I cannot see my client.
units.name: LEONARD

units.text: ^Your Honor, he can see his client perfectly.
units.name: NADINE

units.text: I do not...
units.name: LEONARD

units.text: ...he has been looking at him for ten minutes...
units.name: NADINE

units.text: Quiet!
units.name: JUDGE FAIRCHILD

units.text: Building says generators in five minutes. We will wait.
units.name: JUDGE FAIRCHILD

units.text: Leonard lowers his hand.
Nadine folds her arms.
Your Honor, may I use the time to confer with my client?
units.name: LEONARD

units.text: By all means.
units.name: JUDGE FAIRCHILD

units.text: Your Honor, with respect, the client has no idea where we are.
units.name: NADINE

units.text: Miss Tolliver-Reeves, none of us do.
units.name: LEONARD

units.text: The emergency lights flicker.
Then, all at once, the courtroom blazes with full, merciless brightness.
